relationships.subject: Glutamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Glutamine protected NP cells from TBHP-induced ferroptosis by promoting the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) accumulation by inhibiting its ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and inhibiting lipid oxidation.

relationships.subject: Glutamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Glutamine suppressed oxidative stress-induced cellular processes, including pyroptosis, ferroptosis, and ECM degradation through deubiquitinating Nrf2 and inhibiting lipid oxidation in NP cells.

key_findings: Glutamine stabilizes Nrf2 by deubiquitination, suppressing pyroptosis, ferroptosis and ECM degradation in NP cells.
